mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, external_customer_id, billing_email, company_name, billing_address, tax_id, tax_id_type, currency, created_at, updated_at FROM user_billing_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_billing_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_billing_settings (id, user_id, external_customer_id, billing_email, company_name, billing_address, tax_id, tax_id_type, currency, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{userId}::uuid, #{externalCustomerId}, #{billingEmail}, #{companyName}, #{billingAddress}, #{taxId}, #{taxIdType}, COALESCE(#{currency}, 'USD'), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now()))
mapper.update: UPDATE user_billing_settings SET external_customer_id = #{externalCustomerId}, billing_email = #{billingEmail}, company_name = #{companyName}, billing_address = #{billingAddress}, tax_id = #{taxId}, tax_id_type = #{taxIdType}, currency = #{currency}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid
